items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: Guard stays silent while a launched background task is unfinished and blocks at most once per 10 minutes while the run's own PR is open; docs, contract and module docstring updated.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unparsable timestamps, odd lines and gh failures never release or raise; a task that never reports stops counting after 2 hours.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new inputs beyond transcript text parsed with regexes and json.loads in try/except; no shell.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Background tracking tested on launch/terminal/non-terminal/false-launch/age bound/incremental scan/decide/real hook subprocess; throttle tested for interval, no-PR, reused branch, gh outage, merge. Replayed against a real session: 8 of 9 blocks would have been silent.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: The scan stays incremental; tracking adds substring checks per line.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: Transcript launch tool_result and task-notification (tool-use-id, status) formats verified against a real transcript on disk.

items.name: Test Hygiene Probe
items.note: No tests skipped or weakened; one tuple unpack widened for the new Scan field.
